# PURE KNAW

> PURE KNAW is the research information portal of the Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences, aggregating academic activities, conferences, and research outputs across KNAW institutes.

PURE KNAW serves as a comprehensive repository for research activities and scholarly events organized by or involving KNAW institutes including DANS, IISH, NIDI, NIOO, Huygens ING, Meertens Instituut, and NIOD. The portal documents academic conferences, research presentations, and institutional activities spanning social sciences, humanities, natural sciences, and digital scholarship.

## Key Topics

- Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences (KNAW)
- DANS-KNAW
- International Institute of Social History (IISH)
- Netherlands Interdisciplinary Demographic Institute (NIDI)
- Academic conferences
- Demographic research
- Social science history
- Digital curation
- Semantic web
- Migration history
- European research networks
- Citizen science
- Historical studies
- Institutional research

## International Academic Conferences

- [10th European Social Science History Conference](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/10th-european-social-science-history-conference-10): 10th European Social Science History Conference in Vienna 2014 organized by IISH and KNAW
- [9th European Social Science History Conference](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/9th-european-social-science-history-conference-13): 9th European Social Science History Conference 2014 Glasgow organized by IISH
- [11th Extended Semantic Web Conference (ESWC2014) - Poster&Demo track](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/11th-extended-semantic-web-conference-eswc2014-posterampdemo-trac): ESWC2014 poster and demo track in Crete featuring DANS-KNAW participation
- [26th International Ornithological Congress](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/26th-international-ornithological-congress-2): 26th International Ornithological Congress 2014 Tokyo with NIOO animal ecology research
- [75th Annual Meeting of the Academy of Management (AOM)](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/75th-annual-meeting-of-the-academy-of-management-aom): AOM 2015 conference presentation on aging workforce and hiring discrimination
- [38th Meeting of the European Section of International Society for Heart Research](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/38th-meeting-of-the-european-section-of-international-society-for): 38th European Heart Research meeting June 2024 at Hubrecht Institute

## Specialized Research Workshops & Symposia

- [3rd LIBER Workshop on digital curation](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/3rd-liber-workshop-on-digital-curation): LIBER digital curation workshop on data preservation and trusted repositories by DANS-KNAW
- [6th Annual conference of the Historical Dialogues, Justice, and Memory Network, Amsterdam](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/6th-annual-conference-of-the-historical-dialogues-justice-and-mem): Historical Dialogues conference on transitional justice and genocide studies at NIOD
- [17e Dag van de Sociologie](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/17e-dag-van-de-sociologie-2): 17th Dutch Sociology Day 2017 covering demographic research and family studies

## Research Presentations & Academic Activities

- [A new era for citizen science: combining past expertise with emerging technologies](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/a-new-era-for-citizen-science-combining-past-expertise-with-emerg): Citizen science research presentation on aquatic ecology by NIOO
- [A plant's inheritance : soil legacy effects of crops and wild relatives in relation to plant functional traits](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/a-plants-inheritance-soil-legacy-effects-of-crops-and-wild-relati): PhD defense on soil legacy effects and plant functional traits at NIOO
- [A socio-syntax approach: acquisition of the gender of the definite determiner, and identity construction through gender 'mismatches'](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/a-socio-syntax-approach-acquisition-of-the-gender-of-the-definite): Linguistic research presentation on gender acquisition by Meertens Instituut
- [Adolescents' Expectations About the Timing of Family Life Events: Unraveling the Role of Value Transmission and Modeling](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/adolescents-expectations-about-the-timing-of-family-life-events-u): Demographic research on adolescent family expectations and parental modeling by NIDI

## Public Lectures & Community Engagement

- [A monument for Corry Tendeloo](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/a-monument-for-corry-tendeloo): Public lecture on female politician Corry Tendeloo by Huygens ING
- [Aanpak eenzaamheid onder oudere mensen in Den Haag. Wat helpt en wat helpt niet?](https://pure.knaw.nl/portal/en/activities/aanpak-eenzaamheid-onder-oudere-mensen-in-den-haag-wat-helpt-en-w): Public talk on elderly loneliness interventions in Den Haag by NIDI
